author: cens0r3d
install_msg: quoter loaded. Reply to a message with `[p]quote`, or pass a message link: `[p]quote <link> [--light] [--gray] [--font sans] [--watermark]`. Right-click a message -> Apps -> **Quote** does the same once you run `[p]slash enablecog quoter` and then `[p]slash sync`. The bot needs Attach Files; the host needs Pillow (`[p]pipinstall pillow`).
name: quoter
description: Turns any message into a square quote card: the author's avatar in a coloured ring, the text in a serif, sans, light or monospace face, a gradient background derived from the avatar's own colour, the attribution below and an optional watermark. Works from a reply, a message link or a message context menu, with per-server defaults for font, theme, grayscale, accent and watermark.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data. Avatars are fetched while a card is drawn and are not written to disk.
